Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

—
Numbers xxiii. 10
.

Numbers

The Holy Bible: King James Version

The Israelites wandered in the desert for 40 years before entering Canaan, the promised land. The name of the book comes from two censuses taken during the journey.
